title: KAD-PI Deterministic Promotion Readiness Gate
non_scope: executing shadow routes or canary experiments
enabling automatic promotion or granting shadow authority
benchmarking remote providers or spending paid tokens for synthetic traffic
claiming empirical savings, quality equivalence, or causal benefit without intervention
probabilistic authorization or fuzzy statistical priors
acceptance_criteria: Wayfinder decision establishes multi-dimensional deterministic readiness contract with per-advisory-class evaluation.
Machine-readable schema kad-promotion-readiness-v1 and policy contract define unambiguous states (INSUFFICIENT_DATA, INVALID_EVIDENCE, POLICY_DRIFT, READY_FOR_CANARY_DESIGN).
Readiness evaluation is strictly fail-closed on hash-chain corruption, sequence gaps, historical tampering, and policy/evaluator fingerprint drift.
Per-advisory-class evaluation assesses opportunity class occurrences, divergence counts, and UNKNOWN rates independently.
Strict epistemic separation enforced: READY_FOR_CANARY_DESIGN means only readiness to design an intervention, never promotion authorization or empirical savings claim.
Synthetic test fixtures are unmistakably labeled and cannot masquerade as live evidence.
Operator interface surfaces readiness via bin/kad observatory readiness and bin/kad observatory readiness --json without noisy compact status degradation.
All required TDD test cases pass and full regression suite remains green with zero routing mutations.
description: Deterministic promotion readiness gate evaluating longitudinal observational evidence sufficiency for controlled canary experiment design without granting shadow execution authority or making unsupported causal claims.
